Enabled.title: Multi-factor authentication
Enabled.description: Require a one-time code sent by email, in addition to the password, for every password sign-in without a store: the Backoffice, apps and API clients that sign in with a password. Stores follow this setting unless they override it. Users without a confirmed email or with lockout disabled can't sign in while this is on. The default administrator account has lockout disabled: confirm its email and enable its lockout before turning this on, or you will not be able to sign in to the Backoffice.

StoreMode.title: Multi-factor authentication
StoreMode.description: Whether customers of this store need a one-time code sent by email in addition to the password. Use global setting: follow the global multi-factor authentication setting. Enabled: always required. Disabled: not required for this store's own customer accounts that are not administrators; everyone else follows the global setting.
